supersession_reason: Result-blind static audit found incomplete operators and a causally inverted downstream verdict screen before any new replay or result was read.

eligibility_and_peak_operators.observation_rows: Use nonmissing observed_swe_mm; select the maximum positive value within each observation water_year; earliest date wins ties; skip years whose maximum is nonpositive.
eligibility_and_peak_operators.primary_window: October 1 of water_year - 1 through the observed positive peak date, inclusive; require both dates in the climate/trace chronology.
eligibility_and_peak_operators.right_censoring: Exclude water year 2025 from all primary site summaries and verdict screens; retain it only in explicitly named sensitivity rows.
eligibility_and_peak_operators.modeled_peak: Maximum runtime_swe_after_m within the frozen window; earliest date wins ties.
eligibility_and_peak_operators.peak_deficit: observed_peak_swe_m minus modeled_peak_swe_m; ratios using this denominator are eligible only when it is strictly greater than zero_tolerance_m.

aggregation_operators.annual_first: Compute every metric per site and eligible water year before aggregation.
aggregation_operators.site_summary: Python statistics.median over uncensored eligible annual values; ratio metrics are computed per annual row before the site median.
aggregation_operators.cohort_summary: Count sites passing their site-median rule; do not pool water volume or weight sites by record length.
aggregation_operators.zero_denominators: Represent ratios with incoming, solid loss, or positive peak deficit at or below zero_tolerance_m as null and exclude them from that ratio median; report exclusions.
aggregation_operators.systemic_direction: A primary site-year is eligible when peak deficit and solid-pack loss exceed zero_tolerance_m. Direction is positive when its daily-local signed opportunity divided by peak deficit is greater than zero. Require positive direction at every site and at least 75 percent of eligible primary site-years.

event.grouping: Consecutive active calendar days; any inactive day ends the event.
event.ranking: Descending aggregate event snowpack_swe_loss_m; chronological order breaks ties.
event.reporting: Retain every event; figures may identify the top three per site-year without changing inferential summaries.

hour_class_operators.precipitation: snowfall when snowfall_swe_m > tolerance only; rain when rain_m > tolerance only; mixed_or_both when both; dry when neither.
hour_class_operators.radiation: positive when radiation_mj_m2 > tolerance; zero otherwise.
hour_class_operators.pack_state: pack_present when pack_depth_before_m > tolerance; snow_free otherwise.
hour_class_operators.mixed_signed_day: gross positive applied CoE melt > tolerance and negative applied CoE melt < -tolerance within the same day.
hour_class_operators.components: Report signed A/B/C/D totals and their totals conditional on the sign of the summed applied hourly CoE value; never call them energy shares and never allocate the cap among components.

diagnostic_indices.daily_local_signed_opportunity_primary: For each day, gross positive applied CoE melt minus max(daily signed applied CoE melt, 0); sum daily values over the window; no state feedback.
diagnostic_indices.window_nonlocal_signed_index_secondary: Gross positive applied CoE melt over the window minus max(window signed applied CoE melt, 0); loose nonlocal algebraic index only.
diagnostic_indices.post_coe_stage3_cold_opportunity_seconda: Daily min(stage3 incoming liquid, positive stage3 cold content before / (rho_water * latent_heat_fusion)); this is post-CoE start-of-Stage-3 state, mixes released rain and solid loss, may reuse persistent cold content across days, and has no state feedback.
diagnostic_indices.solid_source_limited_cold_index_secondar: Daily min(snowpack_swe_loss_m, positive stage3 cold content before / (rho_water * latent_heat_fusion)); still post-CoE, temporally reusable, and feedback-free.
diagnostic_indices.overlap: Report daily min(daily-local signed opportunity, post-CoE Stage-3 cold opportunity) as an overlap cap; never add the indices as independent recovery.

descriptive_screens.downstream_capture_throughput: Site median of annual (sum positive producer retained amount + producer refrozen amount) / incoming >= 0.5. This is a diagnostic-arm throughput measure, not endpoint net storage and not causal peak-SWE evidence.
descriptive_screens.upstream_ledger_localization: Site median annual gross-positive applied melt / solid-pack loss lies in [0.8, 1.2]. This localizes the current debit but is not independent evidence that melt is excessive.

causal_adjudication.static_stage3_exclusion: If exact current code and real-consumer evidence confirm Stage-3 retained/routed/refrozen outcomes do not control runtime SWE or downstream liquid publication, DOWNSTREAM_RETENTION_REFREEZE_PRIORITY is excluded regardless of the descriptive throughput screen.
causal_adjudication.signed_materiality: Site median daily-local signed opportunity / positive observed-minus-modeled peak SWE deficit >= 0.25 at three or more sites.
causal_adjudication.signed_systemic: Positive direction at all four sites and at least 75 percent of eligible primary site-years.
causal_adjudication.preexport_priority: Select PREEXPORT_ENTHALPY_OR_SIGNED_HOUR_PRIORITY only when static Stage-3 exclusion, signed materiality, and signed systemic screens all pass. This ranks a contract-first correction family; it does not validate signed netting as physics.
causal_adjudication.upstream_priority: Select UPSTREAM_GENERATION_PRIORITY only when static Stage-3 exclusion passes, signed materiality/systemic does not jointly pass, and upstream ledger localization passes at three or more sites. This is an investigation priority, not proof that CoE forcing or coefficients are excessive.
causal_adjudication.downstream_priority: Not selectable under confirmed current Stage-3 decoupling. If static consumer evidence contradicts decoupling, stop and issue a new result-blind protocol before using this verdict.
causal_adjudication.multifactor_priority: Select only if two causally independent production paths pass prospectively declared materiality screens. Descriptive Stage-3 throughput, cold opportunity, and upstream localization are not independent causal paths.
causal_adjudication.unresolved: Select when real-consumer ordering is not proven, coverage is insufficient, static and dynamic evidence conflict, or no selectable priority rule passes.

claim_limits: CoE A/B/C/D are empirical melt-depth contributions, not physical energy shares
opportunity indices are feedback-free and are not simulated SWE recovery
post-CoE Stage-3 cold content is not pre-CoE or pre-export cold content
positive producer retention plus refreeze is throughput, not endpoint net storage
the linked upstream and downstream ledgers are nested boundaries, not one additive partition
legacy routing is a rollback bound, not correction authority
forcing and observation uncertainty remain unless directly tested
no production correction or calibration is authorized
